headline_marked: AI agents autonomously train robots to cut zip ties, insert GPUs [[with 99% success rate]]
headline: AI agents autonomously train robots to cut zip ties, insert GPUs with 99% success rate
summary: NVIDIA's AI coding agents use ENPIRE framework to train robots autonomously. The agents achieved a 99% success rate in tasks like cutting zip ties and inserting GPUs.
details: NVIDIA's self-improvement program for robots enlists teams of AI coding agents. The agents can apparently figure out a training regimen that teaches the robots to successfully cut zip ties and even insert GPUs into thin sockets on motherboards.

The ENPIRE harness has four modules that enable AI coding agents to perform automatic reset and verification on tasks, refine policies that guide robotic behavior, evaluate such policies across multiple physical robots working in parallel, and address failures by analyzing logs, ingesting research papers, and improving training infrastructure and algorithm code.

The harness was tested with three different AI coding agents, including OpenAI's Codex with GPT-5.5, Anthropic's Claude Code with Opus 4.7, and Moonshot AI's Kimi Code with Kimi K2.6. Teams of the coding agents independently developed different algorithmic approaches to robot training, tested them in real-world experiments, and then retained whatever changes helped raise the overall success rate over repeated cycles of self-directed testing.

Equipped with ENPIRE, the AI coding agents developed strategies for robotic self-improvement that achieved a 99 percent success rate across several manipulation tasks, including the standard 'Push-T' task that challenges robots to move a T-shaped block to fit a target position on top of a table.
caption:

headline_marked: YouTube Music [[tops Android Auto test]] vs Spotify, Amazon
headline: YouTube Music tops Android Auto test vs Spotify, Amazon
summary: YouTube Music beats Spotify and Amazon Music in Android Auto test
details: A recent test of Android Auto music services found YouTube Music to be the most complete and dependable experience. The app had a consistently reliable performance, with minimal playback issues or connection problems.
YouTube Music's value is also hard to ignore, as it comes bundled with YouTube Premium. Spotify and Amazon Music also have their strengths, but fell short in the test.

Spotify had a polished interface and excellent podcast integration, but had limited voice command capabilities with Gemini. Amazon Music had a solid but unremarkable experience, with large buttons and decent audio quality.
caption:
Which music service reigns supreme in Android Auto?

A recent test of Android Auto music services found YouTube Music to be the most complete and dependable experience. The app had a consistently reliable performance, with minimal playback issues or connection problems.

YouTube Music's value is also hard to ignore, as it comes bundled with YouTube Premium. Spotify and Amazon Music also have their strengths, but fell short in the test.

Spotify had a polished interface and excellent podcast integration, but had limited voice command capabilities with Gemini. Amazon Music had a solid but unremarkable experience, with large buttons and decent audio quality.
